title: コーポレートファイナンス
subtitle: Corporate Finance
keywords: Discounted cash flow 2.Dead finance 3.Equity finance 4.Cost of capital 5.Optimal capital structure
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Business Applied Practical Ability” learning and educational goal of the Department of Management Systems. The goal is for the student to understand the basic concepts and methods of finance necessary for corporate management and to develop the ability to analyze and examine specific examples of corporate finance.
advice: In this course, students will first learn the basic concepts that serve as the premise of learning. They will then learn the basic ideas and specific methods related to finance.
requiredKnowledge: This course deals with financial management from a capital procurement perspective. In the course, the contents learned in Basic Accounting, and Profit Management and Funds Management will be utilized. Therefore, students should review the contents of these courses before attending class.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the role of financial markets and financial institutions.
Be able to understand financial management systems.
Be able to understand the time value of money.
Be able to understand various finance methods.
Be able to understand the cost of capital.
Be able to understand the optimal capital structure.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Understand the role of financial markets and institutions and explain the money creation system. ・Be able to explain the financial management system from the aspect of capital procurement/operation management and profit/cash management. ・Understand the significance of the time value of money and calculate it in detail. ・Understand the concept of weighted average cost of capital and calculate it in detail. ・Be able to explain the advantages and disadvantages of various finance methods.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Understand the role of financial markets and financial institutions. ・Be able to briefly explain the financial management system. ・Understand the time value of money ・Understand the concept of capital cost ・Be able to determine what kind of capital procurement is available.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
